name: amfx-gbpusd-rate-diff
description: amFX reproduction (12JUN23 p1 bottom): GBPUSD vs UK/US 10-year rate differential overlay. Companion chart showing GBP reconvergence with rate differentials. Rate diff = UK 10Y minus US 10Y. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: GBPUSD vs UK/US 10-Year Rate Differential
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces bottom chart from page 1 of amFX 12JUN23 newsletter.
# Dual overlay: GBPUSD spot vs (UK 10Y - US 10Y) rate spread.
# Reconvergence pattern is cleaner on GBPUSD than EURGBP.
# Together with the EURGBP chart, builds the case for squaring GBP position.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
gbpusd = src.c

# UK 10-year Gilt yield (monthly, forward-filled to daily)
uk10y_src = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01GBM156N')()
uk10y = ffill(uk10y_src.result)

# US 10-year Treasury yield (daily)
us10y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
us10y = ffill(us10y_src.result)

# Rate differential: UK minus US
rate_diff = uk10y - us10y

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: GBPUSD vs Rate Differential Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='GBPUSD vs UK/US 10Y Rate Differential: Reconvergence Complete?',
    category='FX vs Rates',
    y_axis_label='Rate Diff (pp)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='UK-US 10Y Rate Diff', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GBPUSD', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero Spread', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, rate_diff, gbpusd)
